- Milestone 2: Acceptance window open — target 2025-08-10 to 2025-08-24
- Go-live target (soft): 2025-08-25

1) Split acceptance into two gates: 1) Integration readiness (data pipelines + auth) and 2) Feature acceptance (scoring + model behavior). That reduces chunk size for procurement to sign off on.
2) Offer a limited early-access environment (no ramped throughput) so Acme can begin integration testing before final license execution.
3) PS commitment: we can allocate a 0.6 FTE for onboarding during Milestone 1 week to speed smoke tests, but we need confirmation of revised dates by 2025-07-10.
4) One-time legal addendum: Sales Ops should include a 21-day price-preserve clause and escrow-style acceptance sign-off. I attached the standard clause draft (redwood-terms-ds.docx) for Legal to review.

I will add a risk-log entry in our shared drive and tag owners. If exec sign-off is needed for the price-hold beyond 21 days I recommend we escalate to VP Sales (Rishi, please advise on the security artifacts timeline).
